{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any rows with revenue = '999999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Count how many such rows exist
num_qa = len(qa_rows)

# Check the status of those rows (if any)
qa_statuses = qa_rows['status'].value_counts() if not qa_rows.empty else pd.Series()

# Count completed orders in the full dataset
completed_orders = df['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)

# Print results
num_qa, qa_statuses, completed_orders"}
